**Warning signs.** Eyebrow: Know When to Act · H2: Signs a Failing Tooth Needs Prompt Attention · Cards: **Pain that keeps coming back.** Recurring pain or pain when biting can point to decay, a crack, or infection. / **Swelling or a bad taste.** A gum pimple, bad taste, or drainage may signal infection. / **A loose adult tooth.** Movement can be linked to gum disease, bone loss, or heavy bite forces. / **A deep crack or break.** A fracture below the gumline may leave too little tooth to restore. / **Repairs that keep failing.** Repeat decay or a failing root canal may need a fresh prognosis. / **Trouble chewing.** Favoring one side or sticking to soft foods deserves an evaluation. · Banner: **Pain or swelling right now?** Call (510) 493-2130 for guidance. Seek emergency medical care for trouble breathing or swallowing, rapidly spreading facial swelling, uncontrolled bleeding, or major facial trauma.

**Preserve · Repair · Replace.** Eyebrow: Diagnosis Before Extraction · H2: Should a Tooth Be Preserved, Repaired, or Replaced? · **01 Preserve:** When it fits: a reasonable long-term outlook and enough healthy support. Possible care: monitoring, gum care, a bite adjustment, or a protective restoration. Goal: keep useful natural tooth. / **02 Repair:** When it fits: damage can be treated predictably and the tooth still matters to your bite. Possible care: a filling, crown, root canal, or gum treatment. Goal: restore comfort without replacing too early. / **03 Replace:** When it fits: the tooth can't be restored predictably or poses an infection risk. Possible care: an implant, bridge, partial denture, implant-supported denture, or full-arch treatment. Goal: rebuild with a solution you can maintain. · Closing: Your consultation doesn't commit you to extraction. It gives you a clear prognosis and the reason behind every recommendation.

**Scope.** Eyebrow: Match the Treatment to the Problem · H2: One Tooth, Several Teeth, or a Full Arch? · **One tooth:** Single implant and crown · Traditional bridge · Removable option. / **Several teeth:** Individual implants · Implant-supported bridge · Tooth-supported bridge · Partial denture. / **Most or all teeth:** Implant-supported denture · Fixed full-arch bridge · All-on-4, All-on-6, or All-on-X · Complete denture. · Note: Bone, gum health, space, cost, and your preferences still shape the choice. · Links: Dental implants (https://nobledentalcares.com/our-services/dental-implants) · Crowns and bridges (https://nobledentalcares.com/our-services/crown-and-bridges) · Full and partial dentures (https://nobledentalcares.com/our-services/full-partial-dentures) · ADA overview of dental implants (https://www.mouthhealthy.org/all-topics-a-z/implants, new tab) · All-on-X dental implants near Hayward (https://nobledentalcares.com/all-on-x-dental-implants-hayward-ca, show only when the flag `ALL_ON_X_PAGE_LIVE` is true)

**Waiting.** Eyebrow: Why Timing Matters · H2: What Happens When Failing Teeth Are Left Untreated? · **First:** Symptoms come and go while decay or infection can keep progressing. / **Next:** Chewing shifts to the other side and your bite loses balance. / **Over time:** Gum disease and infection can be associated with bone changes. / **Later:** A repairable tooth may become nonrestorable, and implants may need extra planning or grafting. · Note: Not every tooth follows this path. Only an exam and imaging show your real risk. · CTA: Find Out Where My Teeth Stand

**Same day.** H2: Can Failing Teeth Be Removed and Replaced the Same Day? · Pill: Sometimes, in selected cases. · Body: A failing tooth can sometimes be removed and an implant placed in one visit, and selected full-arch cases can receive fixed temporary teeth on surgery day. It depends on infection, bone, implant stability, gum health, and your bite. Same-day teeth are usually temporary teeth while implants heal. · Chips: Confirmed only after exam and imaging / Temporary and final teeth do different jobs / A soft-food period may apply / Follow-up visits remain essential · Link: Same-day teeth for full-arch implants (https://nobledentalcares.com/our-services/same-day-teeth-for-full-arch-implants)
